_comment: Minimums the recall benchmark must meet. Raise them when quality improves; never lower them to make a change pass.

_open._why: Reported, not gating. Similarity scores cannot separate 'same topic' from 'answers it' (best balanced accuracy 0.63-0.79 across every score feature tried, both embedders; see evals/tune.py). Needs a reranker or a model judging relevance. Until then `match` is a lenient floor.

with_reranker._comment: EVAL_RERANKER=1. Replaces the two match gates: the reranker is strict, so fewer answerable questions are marked strong, and most unanswerable ones are caught.
